tool_args.rationale: The history-dependent gap and transient lag favor the coupled ODE. The pilot horizons already bracket the target H=0.45, so the priority is finer trajectory data that can separate memory relaxation from coupling strength before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: With only five forecast endpoints at similar horizons and no direct memory measurements, coupling strength and memory time scale can trade off.
It costs less, but the unresolved question is how to separate the memory parameters within the coupled model, not which broad mechanism to pursue.
Neither model can explain the observed forecast gap between matched endpoints with different histories.
